title: Cradles
lyrics:
[00:12.69]I live inside my own world of make-believe
[00:18.54]Kids screaming in their cradles, profanities
[00:24.74]I see the world through eyes covered in ink and bleach
[00:30.64]Cross out the ones who heard my cries and watched me weep
[00:36.73]I love everything
[00:39.52]Fire's spreading all around my room
[00:43.23]My world's so bright
[00:44.69]It's hard to breathe but that's alright, hush
[01:12.70]Tape my eyes open to force reality (Oh, no, no)
[01:18.53]Why can't you just let me eat my weight in glee?
[01:24.73]I live inside my own world of make-believe
[01:30.57]Kids screaming in their cradles, profanities
[01:36.47]Some days I feel skinnier than all the other days
[01:42.47]Sometimes I can't tell if my body belongs to me
[01:48.61]I love everything
[01:51.54]Fire's spreading all around my room
[01:55.21]My world's so bright
[01:56.68]It's hard to breathe but that's alright, hush
[02:24.32]I wanna taste your content
[02:26.99]Hold your breath and feel the tension
[02:29.88]Devils hide behind redemption
[02:32.88]Honesty is a one-way gate to hell
[02:36.25]I wanna taste consumption
[02:38.93]Breathe faster to waste oxygen
[02:41.89]Hear the children sing aloud
[02:44.59]It's music till the wick burns out, hush
[03:00.36]Just wanna be care free lately, yeah
[03:05.27]Just kicking up daisies
[03:07.80]Got one too many quarters in my pockets
[03:11.54]Count 'em like the four-leaf clovers in my locket
[03:14.83]Untied laces, yeah
[03:18.59]Just tripping on daydreams
[03:21.05]Got dirty little lullabies playing on repeat
[03:24.75]Might as well just rot around the nursery and count sheep
